title: Adopted repositories keep one AGENTS.md: krn adopt writes no CLAUDE.md on Claude Code 2.1.277+
body:
Evidence: operator note 2026-11-18 and decision single-agents-md; docs https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md#agents-md: Claude Code 2.1.277+ reads AGENTS.md when no CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md exists in the working directory or above (default setting claude-md-or-agents-md); both exist -> CLAUDE.md only.
Outcome: krn adopt on a repository without CLAUDE.md writes none and the adopted session still receives the AGENTS.md rules (verified by a session canary); a repository with both files is reported.
Proof: a canary session in a scratch adopted repo quotes an AGENTS.md-only rule.
Files: src/adopt/init.ts
